signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitleEmail: Sign in or create a new account with your email address.
signIn.emailHint: You don't need a password. We'll send you a one-time password by email. If you don't have an account yet, one will be created.

signIn.otpHint: Didn't get an email? Check your spam folder. Some providers filter it out — a different address may help.
